extraction_notes: The main article refers to ESI Tables S1 and S4 for catalyst compositions, rates, and TOFs, but the ESI tables were not included in the supplied text/images; therefore Ru loading and most tabulated TOFs are null. Figure 4 was small in the supplied page image, so plotted rates were read approximately with qualifier '~'. Arrhenius plot Fig. 4b was not separately extracted because it replots rates as ln(r) rather than reporting additional ammonia synthesis rates.
